title: Chapter 31
text:
Behind the bunker, Kelly gasped for breath in fear. There was a bullet wound on his cheek, and his flesh was torn open. Blood mixed with sweat dripped down his face.

He was so close to following in the footsteps of his teammates and dying under the sudden rain of bullets.

"What kind of monster is that?"

The long-haired guy shouted in horror. His face was pale, and there was a bullet wound on his abdomen that was bleeding profusely.

In the darkness, two red dots were faintly discernible, like two ferocious beasts. Under the horrified gazes of Kelly and the long-haired guy, the first generation ranger revealed its full appearance. Its ten fingers were smoking, and its neckless appearance was adorable. It was hard to associate it with the killing machine just now.

"A robot?"

Kelly's eyes widened.

He regretted not trusting his instincts. The result of his carelessness was that the team was almost wiped out.

What should he do now? Kelly had the intention to retreat. Money could be earned again, but there was nothing left if he lost his life.

After the long-haired guy recovered from his fear, he became extremely angry. He roared and poured bullets at the first generation ranger. "Die, die, die, die!"

The first generation ranger's weak armor was deformed by the bullets. Kelly and the other team members saw this and joined in the counterattack.

Your mechanical creation [First Generation Ranger (Caterpillar Type)] has lost 14 armor points …

Your mechanical creation [First Generation Ranger (Caterpillar Type)] has lost 17 armor points …

…

The first generation ranger's armor was very ordinary, and it could not withstand the damage. Its armor points were quickly depleted, and the two bullet belts were also used up after a round of explosions. It was now a piece of metal with no combat ability.

After all, they were short on resources. Han Xiao did not equip the first generation ranger with more weapons. Two small caliber machine guns was already the limit.

Tsk, why hasn't Division 13 made a move yet?

Han Xiao thought to himself. He did not believe that the secret agents observing in the dark would allow the mercenaries to continue running wild.

As expected, he did not have to wait for too long. The sound of military boots quickly approached. Just by listening to the sound, one could imagine the image of fully armed soldiers moving steadily and accurately.

"Everyone, lay down your weapons!" Someone shouted in the darkness. His tone was cold and harsh.

"Let's retreat quickly." Kelly's heart sank.

The longhaired man's anger had not yet subsided. He emptied the last few bullets in the magazine on the first generation ranger that was about to be scrapped. Only then did he say, "Okay, let's go."

At this time, Han Xiao controlled the 1st Generation Ranger to move, approaching the three mercenaries at high speed. The Ranger's chest suddenly swelled with flames and exploded with a deafening explosion.

Waves of fire and shockwaves spread out in all directions, stirring up a storm of smoke and dust, instantly forming a sea of fire around them.

Self-detonation!

The orange-red flames lit up the dark night!

Dozens of meters away, Li Hui and the other field team agents were shocked by the explosion.

"This is bad." Feng Jun cursed inwardly. The orders from above were not to cause too much of a commotion. Now that the flames could be seen from a few kilometers away, he could already guess the headlines of tomorrow's newspaper.

From the moment Han Xiao exchanged fire with Raccoon, the situation was already out of their control. The gunshots were too loud, and it attracted the attention of many civilians. At that time, the Bee Stinger Squad had not moved yet, so Li Hui and the others had no choice but to follow the order and wait anxiously.

When the Bee Stinger Squad entered the battlefield, the agents could not wait to take action, wanting to minimize the impact. However, the first generation ranger's self-detonation ruined their plan.

The longhaired man and another member were killed, and Kelly was covered in dust. He was completely terrified by Han Xiao's methods. Without saying anything, he turned around and ran.

Han Xiao shook the sand off his hair, not feeling the slightest bit of heartache.

The combat style of a Mechanic was to consume all kinds of machinery. He had the blueprint, so he could rebuild it as long as he had the resources. As long as he gained the experience, he would have already profited, not to mention that he had killed so many people.

Li Hui had no choice but to vent his anger on Kelly. He fired from afar, filled with murderous intent.

"You want to steal my kill?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. He could only complete the concealment requirement by killing all the mercenaries. If Kelly was killed by someone else, all his previous efforts would be wasted.

With that in mind, Han Xiao took action. He moved in an arc, avoiding Li Hui and the others, and intercepted Kelly in front of him.

Kelly stopped in shock. He felt that Han Xiao was like a completely different person, giving him an extremely dangerous feeling.

"Go to hell!"

Kelly gritted his teeth and raised his gun.

Just as his finger was about to pull the trigger, Han Xiao abruptly bent his waist, lowered his center of gravity to his feet, and swayed his body left and right. Like the footwork of a veteran boxer, he moved swiftly like a ghost and quickly closed the distance between them.

Kelly opened fire in panic, but all the bullets were dodged or blocked by Han Xiao's mechanical arm.

"Not even a single shot hit him?"

Kelly had a face of disbelief. He had seen Han Xiao's physical fitness, and it was only about the same as an elite mercenary. It was far from the standard of a Super, so it was impossible for him to be faster than bullets. This proved that Han Xiao had completely predicted the angle of his every shot. Only an ace warrior who had experienced hundreds of battles would have such terrifying experience. Even in his career as a mercenary, he had only seen two or three ace mercenaries with such skill!

Han Xiao chuckled. Compared to the time when he piloted a mechanical suit to avoid thousands of floating cannons, this level of prediction was a piece of cake.

After emptying his bullets, Kelly hurriedly retreated and hurriedly reloaded. However, Han Xiao instantly closed the distance between them, and a look of fear appeared on his face.

Han Xiao straightened his back, and his muscles and bones crackled. Power flowed from his feet into his left hand like an avalanche, driving the Lightweight Mechanical Arm to draw a full arc, and he threw out a heavy punch!

The perfect combination of strength and steel!

"Overload!"

The sound of the air pump piston and gears suddenly became faster, and the heat dissipation pipe spewed out a puff of black smoke. The power instantly increased by thirty percent, and the steel fist smashed right into Kelly's face.

Critical Hit!

Overwhelming Strength!

Kelly's face was instantly smashed open, and bright red juice splattered everywhere.

One hit, one kill!

Li Hui and the others finally arrived, and this was the scene that unfolded in front of them.

Kelly's body softly fell to the ground like a puppet whose strings had been cut. Han Xiao's face was stained with sputtering blood, and the flames cast a mottled shadow on his expressionless face. The ferocious exoskeleton mechanical arm on his left hand was stained with large pieces of flesh, and hot blood droplets dripped down.

Even though the field agents were experienced, they could not help but feel a chill in their hearts.

Level E Mission [Pursuit] completed. Received 10000 EXP.

Hidden Condition: Kill six pursuers. Received Skill Upgrade Card (Basic). Do you wish to receive it?

"No." Now was not the time to receive it.

"Don't move!" Li Hui snapped out of his daze and hurriedly raised his gun.

Han Xiao was expressionless as he took off the Lightweight Mechanical Arm and raised both his hands. Two agents quickly stepped forward and put a black hood over his head.

His vision became pitch black, and Han Xiao felt that he was being pushed forward. He knew that he was going to be taken to Division 13.

You guys are finally here!

Feng Jun looked at the battlefield and sucked in a breath of cold air. "He killed all six mercenaries. Is he relying on these machines to fight?"

Li Hui's expression was serious as he said, "Take away all the parts he left behind and inform the police to deal with the aftermath."

After saying that, the group of people escorted Han Xiao into the car and left in a hurry. It felt like they had come in a hurry and left in a hurry. It felt like they had not done anything at all, which made the field team very frustrated.

Han Xiao sat in the back seat, sandwiched between two agents. Although he could not see anything, he could feel that the other agents were all focused on him.

Behind the black hood, a strange smile appeared.

Although there was a slight deviation, so far, the situation had been within his expectations.

No one spoke in the car, and the atmosphere was tense and silent. Only the sound of the car moving could be heard.

Li Hui and the others were not allowed to talk to the target before they arrived at their destination. However, Han Xiao's calmness had attracted their attention. It was as if he had known that they would appear.

…

Civet looked at the casualties of his subordinates with a gloomy face.

"Give me the laptop!"

He logged onto the Dark Net, entered the bounty section, and immediately saw the bounty with Han Xiao's picture.

"Zero, a bounty of one million, posted by the Germinal Organization?"

Civet's expression changed drastically. His hands trembled, and the laptop fell to the ground.

It really is a f * cking bounty hunter! And a bounty hunter from the Germinal Organization, the leader of the underground world!

If he had known that Han Xiao was such a dangerous person, he would not have dared to make a move!

Ma Jie and Blondie rushed over, gasping for breath. They looked at the traces of the battle in shock and trembled in fear.

Civet was furious when he saw them. He kicked Ma Jie to the ground and roared, "F * ck, this is all your fault! I'll never forgive you! "

Ma Jie clutched his stomach in pain and trembled on the ground like a quail. He did not know what he had done wrong.

Suddenly, the sirens rang. Seven or eight police cars blocked the entrance of the junkyard, and heavy-duty police officers in bulletproof vests swarmed in.

"Hmph, the police are always late." Civet tidied his clothes and walked up to them. In his opinion, he was the victim. Furthermore, he had connections in the police department in District 7, so he was not worried at all.

However, before he could say anything, the heavy-duty police officers pressed him down and handcuffed him.

Civet was stunned. He struggled and yelled, "What are you doing? I'm the victim here! I know the secretary of your department … "

"Don't waste your energy," the heavy-duty police officer said calmly. "This is an order from Division 13."

Civet's eyes widened. Division 13 was in charge of matters related to national security. Why would they target him? I must have been involved in something. Han Xiao's figure flashed across Civet's mind. He could not think of any other possibility.

Is Division 13 backing him up?

Suddenly, a clear line of thought appeared in his mind.

Germinal Organization traitor … Division 13 … Stardragon … Intelligence …

Civet suddenly understood.

They were silencing him!

From the moment Han Xiao purposely took off his mask in front of him, the outcome was already decided.

What a scam!

Civet could no longer keep his cool. His whole body trembled, and his heart was filled with fear and anger.

"Han Xiao! F * ck you! "
